data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2010 opened 2017 with gross claims outstanding of $302.684m (1 Jan 2017). The managing agent reports that loss development for the 2015 year of account and prior years has been broadly favourable, with reserve releases across most years contributing to the closed 2015 year profit. The 2017 calendar year was dominated by multiple large 2017 catastrophe events (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquakes, California wildfires and others) which drove a calendar-year underwriting loss, but mature prior years and reinsurance recoveries produced net releases reflected in the closed 2015 year result. No single gross prior-year movement amount was provided in the report; movements are described qualitatively as benign / releases across most years.
raw_causal_phrases: The loss development activity for this year of account has been relatively benign and the result has just surpassed the upper limit of the previously indicated range due to strong pure year performance across all classes and reserve releases across most years.

The combined 2014 and prior years continued to run off favourably across all classes, this has culminated in a result that exceeds our previous official forecast range +8.5% to +13.5% (September 2017).
The 2015 Year of Account closed on 31 December 2017 with a profit of $77.5 million, inclusive of currency translation but before standard personal expenses.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior years' provision) amount was provided in the notes. The report describes prior-year 'reserve releases across most years' qualitatively and shows a closed 2015 year profit of $77.5m. The claims development data provided is a gross loss-ratio development table (percentages), not an absolute gross claims triangle. As a result, prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. All monetary amounts are reported in the native currency (USD) despite field names including '_gbp_m'.
